access_boundary: Source, protocol, nonresult paper prose and manually specified deterministic economic worlds only. No economic development or confirmation outcome files read. No fresh economic confirmation seeds generated. No technical frozen files or manuscript edited by this reviewer.

checks: Refundable deposits remain liabilities until acceptance and cannot finance readiness or delivery admission.
An adverse insolvency shock cannot spend restricted deposits: the tested failed job refunds the full deposit and records unpaid operating expenses as accounts payable.
Accepted service revenue, cash, receivables, credit allowance, support liabilities, processing payables and reserves remain separate and conserve equity.
Remaining-invoice processing charges and expected credit loss accrue at acceptance and settle or release once upon collection/default.
Failed delivery recognizes no service revenue, refunds the full deposit, and charges resources, processing and recovery.
Conditional commitments are noncash; three high-value commitments fail the declared threshold and four pass it in controlled cases. Screening is charged even without launch.
Changing future realized delivery cost or acceptance draws leaves initial booking unchanged. Changing future startup cost leaves the conditional launch decision unchanged.
A failed first readiness gate incurs 20% of planned startup cost; a failed second gate now incurs 60%, with the final 40% withheld.
Individual member veto, sponsor budget, consent and a cheaper competent broker can prevent purchase. Choices are recomputed for fee and deposit policies.
No-launch preserves seed without creating revenue or profit. Optional retention assessment occurs only after an accepted originating job and is charged once.
Development selects within the declared finite policy family and objective, with all policies and the no-launch comparator retained; there is no global optimum claim.
Forward startup, failed screening, insurance, operating cost and unknown extras are included. Actual unmetered research expense remains unknown rather than free.
limits: Accounting correctness does not calibrate demand, willingness to pay, consent, readiness, success probabilities, insurance or incident severity.

Coalition value and owner participation require an explicit interpretation of the sponsor as procurement agent for the coalition; the same benefit must not be claimed again for a separate fourth actor.
Booking capacity uses fixed day//30 periods, not a rolling 30-day window.

The settlement-tail snapshot completes scheduled invoice/support processing but can retain accounts payable after insolvency. Net available funds correctly deducts those payables; it must not be described as fully discharged obligations.
B assessment and forced-retention comparisons are modeled incremental cases; ordinary reuse of the A-funded product is already in the baseline.

supported_scope: The useful product is a purpose-bound pre-emergency assessment from the beginning; it does not claim a reserve guarantee, physical compatibility or dispatch rights.
The paper identifies established resource-allocation, private inventory matching and MPC prior art, and does not claim a new cryptographic algorithm or historical impossibility.
Privacy as a binding participation constraint is an explicit segment hypothesis; GAO need evidence is not presented as market evidence for this exact product.
Local public-synthetic MPC execution is distinguished from independent organizations, malicious security, authenticated remote deployment, truthful input or security audit.
Hall semantics, unit-capacity distinct assets, asset-specific withholding, every listed scenario, and forall-scenarios/exists-assignment quantifiers are explicit.
One bit per independent world and full batch authorization are explicit; output plus public metadata can leak information.
Discovery attribution separates U/E search records, later cross-round synthesis, supplied formulation and executed implementation; no E-over-U superiority is inferred.
Human-led R&D costs are distinguished from market selling prices and buyer value; low/central/high arithmetic independently reconciles.
Modeled receipts and forward profitability are distinguished from zero actual collections and unknown sunk research expense.
Operational Alpha, incremental retained Alpha, same-information library parity, successor portability and optional Gym are separate.
Next extensions and live validation require new semantics, evidence, funding and authority; they are not included in the tested primitive.
